description: This helper turns a Church boolean into Python's True or False by giving it two Python values.

steps.description: TRUE is a curried function that selects its first argument. FALSE selects its second argument.
church_to_bool applies a Church boolean to Python True and then Python False.

steps.answer: TRUE selects the first argument, Python True.
steps.question: Which Python value does TRUE select in church_to_bool?

steps.description: The first print decodes TRUE through the helper.
The second print decodes FALSE, which selects the second argument, Python False.

title: Decode Church booleans
